$schema-note: Hand-maintained. Read by research/z3/queries.ts; no code change is needed to revise a ruling here.
about: ✎ PENCIL. Every expectation below is what the exhaustive enumeration
(research/conformance/) observed on the date given. None of it has been
triaged by a human. An entry with "triaged": false is an observation, not
a ruling: it records what a run reported, names what would settle the
question, and takes no position on whether the cause is the data, the
run.ts compares each Z3 answer against the expectation here. A
disagreement is the point of the exercise and is reported loudly; it is
not to be silenced by editing this file to match a run.
"triaged" and "finding" fields here should fold into it and be read from
there instead, so a finding has one status and not two.

defaults.$note: The expectation for any query not named in "queries" below. These are the P1.3 properties as stated in issue #1 -- what the theory is being asked to show -- not observations.

CONFLICT/26b-id+30a.observed: The enumeration reported 114048 records in which entry 26b-id (cite 26(b)(i), when fact:activity = activity:trawling) and entry 30a (cite 30(a), when fact:position = position:anchored) both apply and both resolve to 'shall', while 26b-id declares rel:excludes on 30a.
CONFLICT/26b-id+30a.would_settle: A maintainer's reading of Rule 26(a) against the rel:excludes semantics: whether rel:excludes is a claim that the two predicates are disjoint (in which case the predicates or the relation are wrong), or a composition-layer instruction that the excluded entry's lights are not shown (in which case both applying is expected and this check is asking the wrong question).

CONFLICT/26c-id+30a.observed: The same shape as FIND-01 with entry 26c-id (cite 26(c)(i), when fact:activity = activity:fishing) in place of 26b-id: 114048 records where 26c-id and 30a both apply and both resolve to 'shall', with 26c-id declaring rel:excludes on 30a.
CONFLICT/26c-id+30a.would_settle: The same reading as FIND-01; the two stand or fall together.

NO-OBLIGATION/any.observed: The enumeration reported 114048 records in which no entry applies at all, every one of them with fact:position = position:moored. No entry in the pinned applicability.json has a `when` that admits position:moored.
NO-OBLIGATION/any.would_settle: A maintainer's decision on whether position:moored is inside the scope of the lights table at all. Rule 30 names vessels at anchor and aground; facts.json declares position:moored as a value. Either the fact vocabulary is wider than the table intends, or the table is missing a case.

NO-OBLIGATION/not-moored.observed_by: npm run conformance, check consistency-no-obligation, position breakdown
NO-OBLIGATION/not-moored.observed: Every record the enumeration found with zero applied entries had fact:position = position:moored; it found none with any other position. This query asks the solver for the same statement over the reals: with position:moored ruled out, no record leaves every entry inapplicable.
NO-OBLIGATION/not-moored.would_settle: Nothing -- this is the bounded form of the claim rather than an untriaged observation. It is listed here because its expectation is derived from a run's breakdown and not from the property list.
